rows.definition: A provider-neutral declaration of when a session may start, how much active or elapsed effort it should receive, what terminal evidence or limits stop it, and which bounded lifecycle reactions apply.
rows.distinction: Unlike SessionBudget, session intent includes activation, completion, recurrence, and lifecycle policy; unlike NativeScheduler, it grants no authority and performs no scheduling or work.

rows.definition: A deterministic verdict over session intent and measured progress: continue, eligible, complete, timeout, failed, or cancelled, with a receipt-ready reason.
rows.distinction: Unlike a kernel authorization Decision, this evaluates lifecycle timing and completion only and grants no tool capability; unlike a scheduler Decision, it does not choose work placement.
